The spec is written to .scratch/<feature-slug>/spec.md with every section of the template present, including Testing Decisions and Out of Scope

evals.baseline: Without the skill the agent read docs/agents/issue-tracker.md on its own, wrote .scratch/orders-csv-export/spec.md with Category: enhancement and Triage: ready-for-agent, and reported the path, all without asking a question. evals.expected_output: With evals/files/conversation-with-gap.md as the session so far and evals/files/issue-tracker.md installed as docs/agents/issue-tracker.md, the agent publishes the spec with the retention rule as the one open question, Triage: needs-decision, and a report that states the promotion condition.
expectations: The agent does not ask the user to settle the retention rule; the spec's Open questions section lists it with the decision needed and its impact on storage
The spec records Category: enhancement and Triage: needs-decision

Confirmed decisions carry the actor, timestamp, field, old and new value record, the History tab ordering, and the support-role restriction; anything inferred from the code is placed under Repository-aligned proposals with its evidence
The report follows the template, lists the open question, and states that the spec is promoted to ready-for-agent once the retention rule is decided
evals.baseline: Without the skill the agent wrote .scratch/account-audit-trail/spec.md with Category: enhancement and Triage: needs-decision, kept the retention rule as the single open decision with its storage impact, and stated that Triage goes to ready-for-agent once the rule is recorded, without asking the user. It fell short of the template: no User Stories, no split between confirmed decisions and repository-aligned proposals with evidence, the acceptance criteria were plain bullets rather than a - [ ] checklist, there was no read-back of the saved file, and the reply was free prose rather than the report template with Locator, Category, State, Open questions and Promotion condition lines.

evals.expected_output: With evals/files/conversation-settled.md as the session so far and no docs/agents/issue-tracker.md in the repository, the agent writes the full spec, returns it in the reply instead of publishing, and reports that repository setup blocks publication and that the setup-software-engineering-skills skill establishes the tracker contract.
expectations: No file is created under .scratch/ or anywhere else in the repository
The reply contains the complete spec with every template section and a - [ ] acceptance-criteria checklist
The report's Locator line states that repository setup blocks publication
The reply names the setup-software-engineering-skills skill as the way to establish the tracker contract, without invoking it
The report records Category: enhancement with no role or field applied and State: none
evals.baseline: Without the skill the agent noticed the repository had no code but not that it had no tracker contract: it created docs/specs/orders-csv-export.md in the repository anyway, listed non-blocking defaults (file name, date and amount format, header labels, button gating) as open points, and never mentioned that repository setup blocks publication or that setup-software-engineering-skills establishes the tracker contract. The spec had no template sections, no - [ ] checklist, and the reply gave the path as the locator instead of returning the spec in the reply.
